title: Slowly Increasing Steer
source_docs: Vehicle Dynamics Blockset/Vehicle Scenarios/Drive Cycle and Maneuvers/Slowly_Increasing_Steer.md
text: Generate commands to conduct linearly increasing steering maneuver, 2 inputs, 2 outputs; {Maneuver start time, tStart [s]} sets the start time, {Longitudinal velocity setpoint, velRef} sets the target velocity, {Longitudinal velocity setpoint units, velRefUnit []} sets the units, {Steer and countersteer speed, steerRate [deg/s]} sets the steer and countersteer rate, {Steer amplitude, steerAmp [deg]} sets the handwheel steer amplitude, {Steering hold time after max angle reached, tStop [s]}, {Lateral acceleration absolute threshold, ay_max [g]} sets the lateral acceleration threshold, {Initial steer direction} and {Stop simulation at lateral acceleration threshold} sets the option to stop simulation at lateral acceleration. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Steer and countersteer speed, steerRate [deg/s]
params.values: Steer and countersteer rate 13.5 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Steering hold time after max angle reached, tStop [s]
Stop simulation at lateral acceleration threshold
params.values: Option to stop simulation at lateral acceleration threshold off (default) | on
